name: Renovation Budget
description: Creates detailed home renovation budgets with cost-per-square-foot estimates by project type, contingency calculations, and cost-versus-value analysis. Produces a line-item budget table with material, labor, and contingency breakdowns. Use when the user asks about renovation costs, remodeling budgets, home improvement estimates, kitchen or bathroom remodel pricing, or how much a renovation will cost. Do NOT use for new construction budgets, commercial renovation, real estate investment analysis, or interior decorating without structural changes (use interior-design-principles instead).
